# REG.RU
> REG.RU is a Russian domain registrar and hosting provider offering domains, VPS, dedicated servers, cloud services, website tools, and business infrastructure.

REG.RU provides domain registration, web hosting, cloud and server products, SSL certificates, website builders, email, security services, and a customer knowledge base for individuals and businesses.

## Main Products
- [Domains](https://www.reg.ru/domain/): Domain registration, transfer, renewal, and management for Russian and international zones.
- [Hosting](https://www.reg.ru/hosting/): Shared web hosting plans for websites, CMS projects, and small business applications.
- [VPS](https://www.reg.ru/vps/): Virtual private servers with scalable resources for development and production workloads.
- [Dedicated Servers](https://www.reg.ru/dedicated-server/): Dedicated physical servers for high-performance hosting and custom infrastructure.
- [Cloud Servers](https://www.reg.ru/cloud/): Cloud infrastructure services for flexible deployment and resource scaling.
- [SSL Certificates](https://www.reg.ru/sslcertificate/): SSL/TLS certificates for securing websites and online services.
- [Website Builder](https://www.reg.ru/web-sites/): No-code website creation tools for landing pages, business sites, and online presence.
- [Business Mail](https://www.reg.ru/mail/): Domain-based email hosting for teams and organizations.

## Domains
- [Register a Domain](https://www.reg.ru/domain/new/): Search and register available domain names in multiple TLDs.
- [Domain Transfer](https://www.reg.ru/domain/transfer/): Transfer domains to REG.RU from another registrar.
- [Premium Domains](https://www.reg.ru/domain/premium/): Browse and purchase premium domain names with higher market value.
- [Expired Domains](https://www.reg.ru/domain/expired/): Find expiring and released domains available for registration or backorder.
- [WHOIS](https://www.reg.ru/whois/): Check domain registration data and availability information.
- [Domain Prices](https://www.reg.ru/domain/price/): Review registration and renewal pricing across supported domain zones.
- [Domain Zones](https://www.reg.ru/domain/zone/): Explore available domain extensions and their registration terms.

## Hosting and Site Services
- [Web Hosting](https://www.reg.ru/hosting/): Shared hosting plans with control panel access and common CMS support.
- [WordPress Hosting](https://www.reg.ru/hosting/wordpress/): Hosting optimized for WordPress websites and content publishing.
- [CMS Hosting](https://www.reg.ru/hosting/cms/): Hosting environments tailored for popular content management systems.
- [Website Builder](https://www.reg.ru/web-sites/): Build and publish websites using templates and visual editing tools.
- [Site Protection](https://www.reg.ru/siteprotection/): Security services for websites, including monitoring and protective features.
- [CDN](https://www.reg.ru/cdn/): Content delivery network services for faster content distribution and reduced latency.

## Servers and Cloud
- [VPS](https://www.reg.ru/vps/): Virtual servers for hosting applications, databases, and custom services.
- [Linux VPS](https://www.reg.ru/vps/linux/): Linux-based VPS plans for developers and server administrators.
- [Windows VPS](https://www.reg.ru/vps/windows/): Windows virtual servers for Microsoft-based workloads and remote administration.
- [Dedicated Servers](https://www.reg.ru/dedicated-server/): Bare-metal servers with dedicated resources and hardware control.
- [Cloud Servers](https://www.reg.ru/cloud/): Elastic cloud compute resources for scalable infrastructure deployments.
- [Server Administration](https://www.reg.ru/server-admin/): Managed administration services for hosted servers and infrastructure.
- [Backup](https://www.reg.ru/backup/): Backup services for protecting hosted data and server environments.

## Security and Certificates
- [SSL Certificates](https://www.reg.ru/sslcertificate/): Purchase and manage certificates for HTTPS and encrypted connections.
- [Domain Validation SSL](https://www.reg.ru/sslcertificate/dv/): Basic SSL certificates for fast domain-validated website protection.
- [Organization Validation SSL](https://www.reg.ru/sslcertificate/ov/): SSL certificates with organization identity verification.
- [Extended Validation SSL](https://www.reg.ru/sslcertificate/ev/): High-trust certificates with extended business validation.
- [Wildcard SSL](https://www.reg.ru/sslcertificate/wildcard/): Protect a domain and its subdomains with one certificate.
- [Site Protection](https://www.reg.ru/siteprotection/): Security tools for website integrity, availability, and threat mitigation.

## Email and Business Tools
- [Business Mail](https://www.reg.ru/mail/): Professional email hosting on your own domain for business communication.
- [Mail for Domain](https://www.reg.ru/mail/): Create branded mailboxes linked to registered domains.
- [Office and Collaboration](https://www.reg.ru/mail/): Email-focused business communication tools for teams and organizations.
- [Website Builder](https://www.reg.ru/web-sites/): Create business websites without coding using hosted templates.
- [SSL Certificates](https://www.reg.ru/sslcertificate/): Add transport security and trust indicators to business websites.

## Help and Knowledge Base
- [Help Center](https://www.reg.ru/support/help/): Knowledge base with setup instructions, troubleshooting, and service guidance.
- [Domain Help](https://www.reg.ru/support/help/#domain): Support materials for domain registration, transfer, and DNS management.
- [Hosting Help](https://www.reg.ru/support/help/#hosting): Articles covering hosting setup, panels, and website deployment.
- [VPS Help](https://www.reg.ru/support/help/#vps): Guidance for provisioning and administering virtual servers.
- [SSL Help](https://www.reg.ru/support/help/#ssl): Instructions for ordering, validating, and installing SSL certificates.
- [Billing Help](https://www.reg.ru/support/help/#finance): Information about payments, invoices, and account balance operations.
